title: An administrator maintains stations, train types and prices: adding, a refused duplicate, changing and deleting
description: An administrator logs in to the admin console with the administrator's username and password and opens the list of stations. They add a new station Ning Bo with a stay time of 5 minutes, then try to add the existing station suzhou once more, and the system refuses. They change the stay time of the new station Ning Bo to 10 minutes and then delete it. They open the list of train types and change the average speed of the train type GaoTieOne to 280. They open the list of price configurations, change the basic rate of the price configuration for the train type KuaiSu to 0.25 and delete the price configuration for the train type TeKuai.

steps.action: Log in to the admin console with the administrator's username and password
Add a new station Ning Bo with a stay time of 5 minutes
Try to add the existing station suzhou once more (the system refuses: a station with this name already exists)
Change the stay time of the new station Ning Bo to 10 minutes
Open the list of train types
Change the average speed of the train type GaoTieOne to 280
Open the list of price configurations
Change the basic rate of the price configuration for the train type KuaiSu to 0.25
Delete the price configuration for the train type TeKuai
